snippet.title: PARAXIMA | Harvest of Terror: A Horror Game Awards Halloween Showcase 2026 Trailer
snippet.description:
PARAXIMA is a 3-player asymmetric co-op investigative horror. Two Field Agents enter the breach site. One takes the Operator role at the Station in the Safe Room. The goal is to collect evidence, identify the Entity, and solve the paranormal case before the breach site is consumed by the Static forever. It's not about reacting faster than an enemy, or letting tool outputs guide the answer. It about following the rules to survive, and breaking them to come home.

Wishlist PARAXIMA on Steam and check out the demo, available now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3194090/Paraxima/

For future updates follow the game on social media:

TikTok: https://www.tiktok.com/@paraxima_game
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/paraxima/
X: https://x.com/paraxima

Join us on Discord: https://discord.gg/Xhr8ChcxAm

Visit the official Litio Games webpage for more details about the studio: https://www.litiogames.com/

"
---
Originally aired during HARVEST OF TERROR: a Horror Game Awards Showcase on Wednesday 7 October 2026.
---
Set up by two die hard horror game fans, the aim of The Horror Game Awards is simple: to celebrate horror as one of the best genres in video games and to recognise the year’s greatest horror games alongside the developers who make them.
